name: Growth Hacking
source:
The world is falling apart as useable soil is hard to come by anymore. Plants are dying and one scientist has an idea of how to solve the issue. Follow this short horror story with Techno the rabbit and Hex, his fellow robotic friend.

[From [url=https://youchoosewhodies.itch.io/growth-hacking]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界正在崩坏，可用的土壤越来越少。植物不断枯萎，一位科学家想到了一个解决办法。跟随兔子Techno和他的机器人伙伴Hex，体验这段短篇恐怖故事。

[来源：[url=https://youchoosewhodies.itch.io/growth-hacking]itch.io[/url]]
